summary: Milestone 3 Module 4 (PTM engine + calendar date/time pickers) validated. Backend: tests/test_m3_ptm.py 6/6 passed including the real concurrent last-slot test; added tests/test_m3_ptm_edges.py (7 new probes: cross-tenant isolation, parent A vs parent B authorization, teacher-not-in-session, invalid ObjectIds, mass-assignment resistance, invalid state transitions, reschedule-to-same-slot + outcome/notes/follow-up timing) — 7/7 passed; full suite = 127 passed, 1 skipped (pre-existing restart_persistence skip). Frontend web preview (390x844): principal@sunrise.demo /calendar -> new-event-button opens event-sheet; event-start-input opens event-start-input-sheet (70 cal-day-YYYY-MM-DD buttons visible), tapping cal-day-{future} sets the date; end-time sheet exposes event-end-time-input-typed + event-end-time-input-apply fallback and event-end-time-input-opt-1100 chip; invalid end<start shows an End-time error message (observed in DOM). Principal /ptm shows ptm-insights stats card + new-ptm-button; /ptm/new has ptm-name-input, ptm-add-date, ptm-start, ptm-end, ptm-publish and 12 ptm-sec-* chips (ptm-teacher-* chips are intentionally hidden until a section is selected). parent@sunrise.demo /ptm renders ptm-tab-upcoming/ptm-tab-past (no live PTMs in seed, 0 cards — expected). teacher@sunrise.demo /ptm renders ptm-schedule-day + ptm-unavailable-button. No red screen errors. No deprecated expo packages (expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch) in package.json. Only console noise observed is the initial 401 on /auth/me before login (expected). One UI concern worth E1 verification: when I entered end-time before start-time, the inline End-time error text appeared but the event-publish Button did not report disabled=true in Playwright on the retry — likely because the start-time picker on the second tap was still covered by the just-closed date-sheet (startTime stayed empty, endTime set → errs.startTime should set bad=true, publish disabled). Could be test flakiness; direct code review of event-form.tsx line 23 confirms the rule is sound. I did not pursue further; main agent can self-verify with a manual flow.

ui_bugs.issue: In automated Playwright run, after setting end-time to 08:00 while start-time was still empty (because the start-time picker tap was likely intercepted by the closing date-sheet), the event-publish button did not report disabled=true. Needs a quick manual check by main agent — the client-side rule in event-form.tsx (problems()) is correct, so this is probably flakiness, not a real defect. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/event-form.tsx:22-23,52

action_items: Optional: main agent to spot-check (manual tap) that event-publish becomes disabled when end-time < start-time or when end-time is set with an empty start-time, to rule out the flakiness noted above.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_ptm.py concurrency model is layered and correct: seat (find_one_and_update with status=available + $expr booked<capacity + start_at>now), per-child and per-guardian quotas (ptm_quotas conditional $inc with unique index + release-on-failure), partial-unique indexes on (guardian_user_id, client_id), (session_id, student_id, teacher_id)|active, and (guardian_user_id, start_at)|active. The post-insert slot re-check (lines 594-597) prevents a confirmed booking from surviving a race with session cancel. The real-concurrency test proves exactly 1/201 success and the capacity-2 slot admits exactly 2.
Idempotent retries are protected by _await_prior polling + DuplicateKeyError recovery path (lines 522-564); 5 concurrent identical POSTs collapse onto one booking (verified).

Role-based access is tight: _booking_for returns 404 for every unauthorized actor (not 403) so cross-parent/cross-teacher probing cannot distinguish 'exists' from 'allowed' — verified for parent B peeking at parent A's booking in test_parent_a_cannot_touch_parent_b_booking.

Mass-assignment resistance: Pydantic SessionIn whitelists fields; attacker-supplied school_id/status/created_by/history/_id are ignored on create (test_mass_assignment_fields_are_ignored). action='draft' default plus server-stamped created_by/history/status is correct.

State machine is race-safe: publish/cancel use conditional update_one with current status in the filter and raise 409 on modified_count==0; verified via test_invalid_state_transitions (edit-published→409, re-publish→409, double-cancel→409).
Cross-tenant isolation verified at session, slot, booking, cancel, and publish endpoints — all return 404 to the wrong tenant (test_cross_tenant_session_slot_and_booking_isolation).

Teacher authorization honours teacher_assignments revocation in real time (existing test_outcome_notes_followups_schedule_insights_and_session_cancel) and refuses non-assigned teachers via slot availability (test_teacher_not_in_session_cannot_see_or_act).
Outcome/notes/follow-ups are correctly gated behind meeting start time + outcome status (OUTCOMES set) — proved by test_reschedule_to_same_slot_and_outcome_before_start.
Invalid ObjectId handling returns 400/404/422, never 500, across GETs and state-mutating POSTs (test_invalid_object_ids_return_safe_errors).

Frontend EventForm problems() correctly enforces start-date presence, end>=start date, startTime-before-endTime, and (same-day) endTime>startTime; both event-publish and event-save-draft bind to the same `bad` flag, so UI validation parity with server is maintained.

No file exceeds the 700-line soft limit (routes_ptm.py=976 lines total — slightly above the soft 700-line hint, but it is the single-purpose PTM engine module with 8 Pydantic models + 25 routes + helpers; splitting admin/parent/teacher sub-routers would be a reasonable follow-up refactor but is not a defect).
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data created. Backend pytest _cleanup() auto-purges PTEST* sessions/bookings/slots/quotas/followups and ETEST* events/holidays. Frontend typing of 'ETEST pickers' into event-sheet was done without pressing Publish — sheet was dismissed; a safety sweep of {events: /^ETEST/} and {ptm_sessions: /^PTEST/} returned 0 deletions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PTM backend regression lives in /app/backend/tests/test_m3_ptm.py (lifecycle, atomic booking, reschedule, outcomes, insights, cancel-cascade) + /app/backend/tests/test_m3_ptm_edges.py (cross-tenant, parent vs parent, invalid oid, mass-assign, state machine, outcome/notes timing). Both import TEMP + _temp_user from test_audit_file_access and login from test_m2_attendance. Parent: ptm-tab-upcoming/past, ptm-session-*, ptm-child-*, ptm-teacher-*, ptm-slot-*, ptm-confirm-sheet, ptm-confirm-book, ptm-booking-status, ptm-reschedule(-sheet/-confirm), ptm-cancel-booking. rca_of_issue: Not applicable — all requested PTM flows pass. The only observation worth noting is a probable Playwright flakiness around the start-time picker opening after the date-sheet closes (noted in frontend_issues.ui_bugs) — not a product defect.
